headline: VERTICES PARTNERS, Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas act on Elevate Education ₹170 crore Series D fundraise
sum: Elevate Education, formerly known as Sunstone, has raised ₹170 crore from a Series D fundraise led by WestBridge Capital, with participation from existing investors. VERTICES PARTNERS advised Elevate Education on this fundraise.
detail: Elevate Education, formerly known as Sunstone, has raised ₹170 crore from a Series D fundraise led by WestBridge Capital, with participation from existing investors. VERTICES PARTNERS advised Elevate Education on this fundraise. The transaction was led by Vinayak Burman (Founder and Managing Partner) and Vikrant Anand (Partner), along with a team that included Manan Kapoor (Associate Manager), Hemant Srivastava (Associate Manager) and Abhishikha Moyal (Associate). Vikrant Anand, Vinayak Burman Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised lead investor WestBridge Capital on this fundraise.
